title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity & v1.42.1 bumps
author: Priya Desai
description:
Motivation: Multiple SDKs diverged in auth retry semantics and streaming ergonomics which caused inconsistent behavior across hosted/dedicated/private deployments and led to customer confusion and parity bugs. This PR consolidates the auth/retry primitives, streamlines streaming API ergonomics, and applies parity fixes and minor version bumps across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs.

What I changed (high level):
- Introduced a small common auth/retry interface and behavior contract across SDKs: token refresh hooks, retryable-status classification, exponential backoff with jitter, and idempotency guidance.
- Standardized streaming API surface: unified client-side helpers for reconnect/resume, single-shot vs. streaming call patterns, and consistent chunk/event typing across SDKs.
- Ergonomics improvements: simplified client constructors, clearer errors, and improved docs/examples for common patterns (auth refresh, streaming reconnect).
- Parity fixes: aligned TypeScript and Go behavior with Python for header propagation, content-type negotiation, and function-calling metadata.
- Version bumps: Python v1.42.1, TypeScript v1.42.1, Go v1.42.1 with CHANGELOG entries.
- Tests: added cross-SDK integration smoke checks and unit tests that mock the control plane for auth flows.

Files changed (summary): redwood-sdk-python/* (auth.py, streaming.py, client.py, CHANGELOG.md), redwood-sdk-typescript/* (auth.ts, stream.ts, index.ts, CHANGELOG.md), redwood-sdk-go/* (auth.go, stream.go, client.go, CHANGELOG.md), docs/sdk/*, examples/streaming-reconnect, tests/sdk/*

Testing and CI: Local unit + integration suite run. CI initially reported a flaky test (python::tests::test_stream_reconnect) that timed out; I adjusted the test to use a deterministic retry backoff multiplier and reran the pipeline. All checks passed on rerun.

Migration notes: Backwards-compatible for most users. A small subset of advanced users who relied on the previous streaming chunk event types will see a minor shape change; documented migration snippet included in CHANGELOGs. Auth/retry defaults are safer (stricter retry on 5xx, non-retry on 4xx except 429) — customers can override via the client options.

Checklist:
- [x] Python SDK changes implemented and unit-tested
- [x] TypeScript SDK changes implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Go SDK changes implemented and unit-tested
- [x] Integration smoke tests added
- [x] CHANGELOGs updated for three SDKs
- [x] Docs + examples updated
- [x] Linear tasks referenced: ENG-1421, ENG-1435

Rollout plan: Release SDK patch versions and coordinate a short blog/changelog post. Monitor usage for increased retry volumes or unexpected reconnects; rollback plan is to cut patch reverting the streaming ergonomics if customers report regression.

Related: previous parity PRs iterated on this surface (see history of sdks-auth-retries-streaming parity bumps).
